text:
samir_ml: Quick intake — put together a risk matrix for the new 14B-variant quant plan (gguf INT8 / FP8 options). TL;DR: INT8 cheaper (~2.5x), FP8 smaller regression risk for instruction-following. Need prioritization and a short smoke checklist we can run on Dedicated.

tara-eng: :eyes: can you drop the cost numbers and perf targets? what's acceptable latency delta?

samir_ml: Perf targets: p95 ≤ 450ms on 8k tokens (our bench); budget: ≤ $0.35/k token (hosted equivalent). Cost delta rough: INT8 ~ -60% compute, FP8 ~ -40%. Quality risk: INT8 might drop 1–3% on instruction-style metrics; FP8 typically 0.2–1%.

olga_eval: Proposal: run the 100-shot eval suite + 200 synthetic hallucination probes. If pass <1% regression and hallucination stable, green. Otherwise fallback to FP8 or per-layer hybrid. Also add a short prompt-sensitivity run (rewrite prompts, check rank stability).

dennis_runtime: For smoke actions let's keep it tiny so oncall can run fast: 1) quick generation smoke (10 prompts) 2) KV cache correctness check 3) perf probe (p50/p95). Commands to run locally: 

```
# smoke-run
python infra/evals/run_smoke.py --model my14b-gguf-int8 --samples 10 --log out/smoke.log
curl -s -X POST https://redwood.local/internal/generate -d '{"model":"my14b-gguf-int8","prompt":"Translate to French: Hello"}' | jq .
# perf probe (microbench)
python infra/bench/probe_latency.py --model my14b-gguf-int8 --seq-len 2048
```

samir_ml: Also add fallback routing: if p95 spikes >2x baseline or error_rate >0.5% route to "my14b-fp8". I'll update rollout config with a canary (5% traffic) + auto rollback rule.

calib-bot: profile_job/2965432120 finished. sample_stats: mean_logits_shift=0.03, layer_outliers=[17,28], quant_noise_est=0.007. Suggest per-layer scale clamp on layers 17-20 and re-run sensitivity on instruction-following prompts.

tara-eng: Nice — can someone own the initial smoke tomorrow morning US-west? @dennis_runtime? :thumbsup:

dennis_runtime: I'll run it at 09:00 PT, will collect logs + perf traces and post summary here. Planning to run on one dedicated shard.

olga_eval: If we see >2% instruction-regression or any hallucination uptick, abort rollout and mark the model for hybrid quantization investigation. Add notes to onboarding doc (onboard/14b_quant_notes.md).

samir_ml: Perfect. I'll create a short PR with the risk matrix, rollout knobs, and the smoke checklist after dennis posts logs. Thanks everyone.
